### R

```{r}
#| label: second-order-condition-3d-r
#| echo: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| eval: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| fig-alt: >-
#|   Two surface plots side by side. The left plot, titled positive definite
#|   Hessian, shows x squared plus y squared minus 2x over x from -1.5 to 2.5
#|   and y from -1.5 to 1.5, a bowl opening upward whose lowest point, at (1,
#|   0), is marked by a blue circle. The right plot, titled indefinite
#|   Hessian, shows x squared minus y squared over the same region, a saddle
#|   that rises along the x axis and falls along the y axis. The origin, at
#|   the middle of the saddle, is marked by a vermilion diamond.
so_x_sf <- seq(-1.5, 2.5, length.out = 101)
so_y_sf <- seq(-1.5, 1.5, length.out = 101)
so_grid_sf <- tidyr::expand_grid(x = so_x_sf, y = so_y_sf)
so_bowl_value_sf <- so_grid_sf$x^2 + so_grid_sf$y^2 - 2 * so_grid_sf$x
so_saddle_value_sf <- so_grid_sf$x^2 - so_grid_sf$y^2
so_ny_sf <- length(so_y_sf)
so_bowl_sf <- matrix(so_bowl_value_sf, nrow = so_ny_sf)
so_saddle_sf <- matrix(so_saddle_value_sf, nrow = so_ny_sf)
so_min_sf <- list(color = "#0072B2", size = 6, symbol = "circle")
so_pt_sf <- list(color = "#D55E00", size = 6, symbol = "diamond")
so_title_left_sf <- list(
  text = "positive definite Hessian",
  x = 0.22,
  y = 1,
  xref = "paper",
  yref = "paper",
  showarrow = FALSE
)
so_title_right_sf <- list(
  text = "indefinite Hessian",
  x = 0.78,
  y = 1,
  xref = "paper",
  yref = "paper",
  showarrow = FALSE
)
so_titles_sf <- list(so_title_left_sf, so_title_right_sf)
so_eye_sf <- list(x = 1.6, y = -1.6, z = 0.9)
so_camera_sf <- list(eye = so_eye_sf)
so_xaxis_sf <- list(title = "x")
so_yaxis_sf <- list(title = "y")
so_zaxis_sf <- list(title = "f")
so_left_sf <- c(0, 0.5)
so_right_sf <- c(0.5, 1)
so_dom_left_sf <- list(x = so_left_sf)
so_dom_right_sf <- list(x = so_right_sf)
so_scene_left_sf <- list(
  xaxis = so_xaxis_sf,
  yaxis = so_yaxis_sf,
  zaxis = so_zaxis_sf,
  camera = so_camera_sf,
  domain = so_dom_left_sf
)
so_scene_right_sf <- list(
  xaxis = so_xaxis_sf,
  yaxis = so_yaxis_sf,
  zaxis = so_zaxis_sf,
  camera = so_camera_sf,
  domain = so_dom_right_sf
)
so_stops_sf <- c(0, 1)
so_cols_sf <- c("#CCE0F0", "#0072B2")
so_scale_sf <- list(so_stops_sf, so_cols_sf)
plotly::plot_ly() |>
  plotly::add_surface(
    x = so_x_sf,
    y = so_y_sf,
    z = so_bowl_sf,
    colorscale = so_scale_sf,
    showscale = FALSE,
    opacity = 0.8,
    scene = "scene"
  ) |>
  plotly::add_surface(
    x = so_x_sf,
    y = so_y_sf,
    z = so_saddle_sf,
    colorscale = so_scale_sf,
    showscale = FALSE,
    opacity = 0.8,
    scene = "scene2"
  ) |>
  plotly::add_markers(
    x = 1,
    y = 0,
    z = -1,
    marker = so_min_sf,
    scene = "scene"
  ) |>
  plotly::add_markers(
    x = 0,
    y = 0,
    z = 0,
    marker = so_pt_sf,
    scene = "scene2"
  ) |>
  plotly::layout(
    scene = so_scene_left_sf,
    scene2 = so_scene_right_sf,
    annotations = so_titles_sf,
    showlegend = FALSE
  )
```

### Python

```{python}
#| label: second-order-condition-3d-python
#| echo: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| eval: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| results: asis
#| fig-alt: >-
#|   Two surface plots side by side. The left plot, titled positive definite
#|   Hessian, shows x squared plus y squared minus 2x over x from -1.5 to 2.5
#|   and y from -1.5 to 1.5, a bowl opening upward whose lowest point, at (1,
#|   0), is marked by a blue circle. The right plot, titled indefinite
#|   Hessian, shows x squared minus y squared over the same region, a saddle
#|   that rises along the x axis and falls along the y axis. The origin, at
#|   the middle of the saddle, is marked by a vermilion diamond.
import numpy as np
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from plotly.subplots import make_subplots

so_x_3d = np.linspace(-1.5, 2.5, 101)
so_y_3d = np.linspace(-1.5, 1.5, 101)
so_xx_3d, so_yy_3d = np.meshgrid(so_x_3d, so_y_3d)
so_bowl_3d = so_xx_3d**2 + so_yy_3d**2 - 2 * so_xx_3d
so_saddle_3d = so_xx_3d**2 - so_yy_3d**2
so_scale_3d = [[0, "#CCE0F0"], [1, "#0072B2"]]
so_axes_3d = dict(
    xaxis_title="x",
    yaxis_title="y",
    zaxis_title="f",
    camera=dict(eye=dict(x=1.6, y=-1.6, z=0.9)),
)
so_fig_3d = make_subplots(
    rows=1,
    cols=2,
    specs=[[{"type": "scene"}, {"type": "scene"}]],
    subplot_titles=("positive definite Hessian", "indefinite Hessian"),
)
so_fig_3d.add_trace(
    go.Surface(
        x=so_x_3d,
        y=so_y_3d,
        z=so_bowl_3d,
        colorscale=so_scale_3d,
        showscale=False,
        opacity=0.8,
    ),
    row=1,
    col=1,
);
so_fig_3d.add_trace(
    go.Surface(
        x=so_x_3d,
        y=so_y_3d,
        z=so_saddle_3d,
        colorscale=so_scale_3d,
        showscale=False,
        opacity=0.8,
    ),
    row=1,
    col=2,
);
so_fig_3d.add_trace(
    go.Scatter3d(
        x=[1],
        y=[0],
        z=[-1],
        mode="markers",
        marker=dict(color="#0072B2", size=4, symbol="circle"),
    ),
    row=1,
    col=1,
);
so_fig_3d.add_trace(
    go.Scatter3d(
        x=[0],
        y=[0],
        z=[0],
        mode="markers",
        marker=dict(color="#D55E00", size=4, symbol="diamond"),
    ),
    row=1,
    col=2,
);
so_fig_3d.update_layout(scene=so_axes_3d, scene2=so_axes_3d, showlegend=False);
so_html_3d = so_fig_3d.to_html(full_html=False, include_plotlyjs="cdn")
print("```{=html}\n" + so_html_3d + "\n```")
```

```{python}
#| label: second-order-condition-3d-python-static
#| echo: !expr isFALSE(knitr::is_html_output())
#| eval: !expr isFALSE(knitr::is_html_output())
#| fig-alt: >-
#|   Two surface plots side by side. The left plot, titled positive definite
#|   Hessian, shows x squared plus y squared minus 2x over x from -1.5 to 2.5
#|   and y from -1.5 to 1.5, a bowl opening upward whose lowest point, at (1,
#|   0), is marked by a blue circle. The right plot, titled indefinite
#|   Hessian, shows x squared minus y squared over the same region, a saddle
#|   that rises along the x axis and falls along the y axis. The origin, at
#|   the middle of the saddle, is marked by a vermilion diamond.
#| fig-height: 4.5
#| fig-width: 6
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

so_x_3d = np.linspace(-1.5, 2.5, 101)
so_y_3d = np.linspace(-1.5, 1.5, 101)
so_xx_3d, so_yy_3d = np.meshgrid(so_x_3d, so_y_3d)
so_bowl_3d = so_xx_3d**2 + so_yy_3d**2 - 2 * so_xx_3d
so_saddle_3d = so_xx_3d**2 - so_yy_3d**2
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(7, 3.5))
ax_bowl = fig.add_subplot(1, 2, 1, projection="3d")
ax_bowl.plot_surface(so_xx_3d, so_yy_3d, so_bowl_3d, color="#0072B2", alpha=0.6)
ax_bowl.scatter([1], [0], [-1], marker="o", color="#0072B2", s=50)
ax_bowl.set_title("positive definite Hessian")
ax_saddle = fig.add_subplot(1, 2, 2, projection="3d")
ax_saddle.plot_surface(so_xx_3d, so_yy_3d, so_saddle_3d, color="#0072B2",
                       alpha=0.6)
ax_saddle.scatter([0], [0], [0], marker="D", color="#D55E00", s=50)
ax_saddle.set_title("indefinite Hessian")
for ax in (ax_bowl, ax_saddle):
    ax.set_xlabel("x")
    ax.set_ylabel("y")
    ax.set_zlabel("f")
plt.show();
```

:::

The [graphs](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-graph) of the two [functions](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-function) in @exm-second-order-condition,
the surfaces whose [level curves](vector-calculus.qmd#def-level-set) are in @fig-second-order-condition.
The surface of $x_1^2 + x_2^2 - 2 x_1$ is a bowl,
and its [stationary point](#def-stationary-point) $\tp{(1, 0)}$ (circle) is the bottom,
a [strict local minimizer](#def-strict-local-minimizer).
The surface of $x_1^2 - x_2^2$ is a saddle:
it rises along the first coordinate axis and falls along the second,
so the stationary point $\vzero$ (diamond) is not a [local minimizer](algebra.qmd#def-local-minimizer).

:::
